subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Cooling Towers: Rejecting Heat
description: A fast breakdown of Cooling Towers: Rejecting Heat for builders.

hook.text: Power plants make heat. Cooling towers dump it into the sky.

buildup.text: Hot water trickles down while air flows up. Evaporation cools the water.

discovery.text: The huge plumes rising from towers are water vapor, not smoke.

twist.text: A large power plant evaporates enough water to fill a swimming pool per minute.

climax.text: Without cooling towers, thermal plants couldn't run. Heat must leave.

punchline.text: Making power is easy. Getting rid of the heat is the hard part.

quiz.question: How do cooling towers remove heat from water?
options: Refrigerant coils absorb the heat inside the tower
Evaporation cools the water as air flows past it
Cold groundwater mixes with the hot water inside
